author: Muhammed Yasin Yılmaz
scope: The Cevahir Zihin theory (a Living Evidence Mind) and the work since v5: sleep and dream sorting, hearing, felt not-knowing, think-then-speak, situation resemblance, online life, exploration, learning to learn (mixed), one-shot evidence (off), a faster bit-identical core and a smaller tie layout; recall of what was read once; exact relations; analogy and corroboration; paradigmatic relation and binding; relational memory; the reply relation (compositional generalisation: SCAN 789/844 within a window of 11 and 844/844 with a window of 12, against a Transformer's 0/844); generalised consequences; word forms; deduction with exceptions in one and two steps (off by default); witness reliability (off); replacement witness (Mill's method of difference, off); urge to go on (off); attribution with contradictions (!neden); a Turkish audit with negative results. Not separate paper DOIs.
